method: Executed differential (evidence tier 1): ../oracle/B8b-dbs/driver.cpp compiled with libOpenMS's Release flags against the Linux x86_64 Release install openms4-release-bc9cc12-c19e494-174b576 and run twice on ibminode06, each case in a fresh process with OPENMS_DATA_PATH set to the install's share directory, both runs byte-identical. ProteaseDB::getInstance() there loads the built-in provider and share/OpenMS/CHEMISTRY/Enzymes.xml (sha256 2f160f3ec32db6257cb4eee43fd594b48cb36398a17b7af21bbba76bc8b16995, the file enzymes.rs is generated from). Transcribed ProteaseDB_test.cpp literals are tier 3.

source_files.role: The ported header: the provider constructor, the four engine-name listings and writeTSV.
Default constructor (built-in provider, then the optional Enzymes.xml provider), the listings and writeTSV.
Header-only base: getEnzyme, getEnzymeByRegEx, getAllNames, hasEnzyme (both), hasRegEx, the iterators, addEnzyme_ with its replace-by-name rule and the pointer-ordered set.
The 33 compiled-in definitions, in the same order as Enzymes.xml.
The optional Enzymes.xml provider whose definitions replace the built-in ones by name.
toLower: per-byte std::tolower, the lower-cased name key.
